description: A white AirPods-style charging case with a charging cable attached lies on the pink bed sheet in front of the hands. The left hand moves in from the left to grasp the case as a left-hand object, while the right hand comes in from the right to pinch and pull the cable connector out, making the cable a right-hand object; then the left hand slides the case up and away while the right hand lowers the unplugged cable and releases it onto the sheet.
